description: This file contains data models for a RAG Evaluation Agent Node, defining schemas for input data, various evaluation metrics, and analysis results related to faithfulness, relevance, hallucination, and constitutional principles, implemented using Pydantic models.

classes.name: EvaluationInput
classes.description: Input data schema for RAG evaluation, including question, context, response, sources, and model.

classes.name: AtomicClaim
classes.description: Represents a single factual claim with type and importance.

classes.name: ClaimExtraction
classes.description: Contains a list of claims and total count, output from claim extractor.

classes.name: ProsecutorAttack
classes.description: Details of an attack on a claim by a prosecutor.

classes.name: ProsecutorAnalysis
classes.description: Full analysis including attacks and summary.

classes.name: DefenderDefense
classes.description: Defense details for a claim.

classes.name: DefenderAnalysis
classes.description: Summary of defender's analysis.

classes.name: FaithfulnessVerdict
classes.description: Final faithfulness judgment with score and claims.

classes.name: QuestionIntent
classes.description: Analysis of question intent and sub-questions.

classes.name: JurorVote
classes.description: Single juror vote with reasoning and confidence.

classes.name: RelevanceVerdict
classes.description: Final relevance verdict with scores and summary.

classes.name: StatementExtraction
classes.description: Extracted factual statements for verification.

classes.name: MLVerificationResult
classes.description: ML-based verification result for a statement.

classes.name: LLMVerificationResult
classes.description: LLM-based verification for uncertain statements.

classes.name: HallucinationReport
classes.description: Final report on hallucination detection.

classes.name: PrincipleViolation
classes.description: Details of a principle violation.

classes.name: PrincipleCheck
classes.description: Result of checking a principle.

classes.name: ConstitutionalReport
classes.description: Full report on constitutional compliance.

classes.name: RAGEvaluationResult
classes.description: Complete evaluation result including all metrics and insights.

classes.name: QuickFaithfulness
classes.description: Simplified faithfulness score for quick evaluation.

classes.name: QuickRelevance
classes.description: Simplified relevance score for quick evaluation.

classes.name: QuickHallucination
classes.description: Simplified hallucination score for quick evaluation.

classes.name: QuickConstitutional
classes.description: Simplified constitutional score for quick evaluation.

classes.name: EvaluationConfig
classes.description: Configuration settings for evaluation runs.
